description: Fetch a document from a URL, classify its type (personal/medical/business/unknown) with keyword + PII-pattern heuristics (documents containing actual PII data are NEVER business), and return extracted text capped at 100K chars. Free. STREAMING SUPPORTED: send Accept: text/event-stream for started/fetched/classifying/completed phases.

document_url.description: Public HTTPS URL (fetched server-side, 30s timeout; text/* formats classify, binary answers unknown).

name: document.extract
